metadata.case_name: CHAN TSZ WING v. WONG WING KWONG

injuries.description: fracture distal radius and ulna of right wrist; and contusion of right shoulder, left knee and forehead.
injuries.body_part: right wrist; right shoulder; left knee; forehead
source: She was diagnosed with fracture distal radius and ulna of right wrist; and contusion of right shoulder, left knee and forehead.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at other specified part of wrist or hand level

injuries.description: fracture of the left leg due to a fall in a swimming pool on 27 July 2010 of which she already fully recovered by the time of the Accident.
source: Prior to the date of the Accident, she had a fracture of the left leg due to a fall in a swimming pool on 27 July 2010 of which she already fully recovered by the time of the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower leg, including ankle, unspecified

injuries.description: contusion of the face, left clavicle and left leg.
source: She was diagnosed to suffer contusion of the face, left clavicle and left leg.

injuries.description: contusion of both shoulders, left knee, right leg and right face.
injuries.body_part: both shoulders; left knee; right leg; right face
source: She was diagnosed with contusion of both shoulders, left knee, right leg and right face.

manifestations.description: pain and deformity over right wrist
pain and bruising over right shoulder and forehead
easier tiredness of the hand, and needed more frequent breaks during prolonged writing and drawing
abrasion and swelling over the left clavicle/shoulder area and bruising over right eyebrow and left leg; "black eye" swollen for around 2-3 weeks
swollen face and embarrassment/distress from teasing by classmates
bruising over right leg, swelling over left knee, and pain over right angle of jaw, left posterior pelvis and both shoulders

treatments_received: admitted to the Accident & Emergency Department of Tseung Kwan O Hospital (TKOH)
admitted to the orthopaedics ward of TKOH
long arm cast for right wrist fracture
long arm cast trimmed to a short arm cast on 2010-10-13
follow-up at the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Prince of Wales Hospital (PWH)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from fracture distal radius and ulna of right wrist and associated contusions; PSLA awarded at HK$150,000.
Pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from contusion of the face, left clavicle and left leg; PSLA awarded at HK$50,000.
Pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from contusion of both shoulders, left knee, right leg and right face; PSLA awarded at HK$80,000.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ng Wai Yip v Borich Contracting Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: 26 year old plaintiff sprained his left wrist; scaphoid fracture in his left wrist; reduction and screw fixation surgery; hospitalised for 5 days; implant removal performed 6 months later.
